# i3dnet_network (Data Source)

Reads one network by its ID. Use it for networks created outside Terraform, for example networks i3D.net set up for your account. Terraform only reads the network: it does not manage, change or destroy it.

The read fails if no network with this ID exists on your account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read a network that was created outside Terraform, for example one i3D.net
# set up for your account. Terraform does not manage or destroy it.
data "i3dnet_network" "legacy" {
  id = "3f2b8c1e-7d4a-4e9b-9c2f-1a6d5e8b0c47"
}

output "legacy_vlan_id" {
  value = data.i3dnet_network.legacy.vlan_id
}

output "legacy_routing_domain_id" {
  value = data.i3dnet_network.legacy.routing_domain_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID (UUID) of the network to read.

### Read-Only

- `addressing_source` (String) Where the network's addresses come from: `provider` (i3D.net supplies them) or `none` (the network has no i3D.net addresses).
- `connectivity` (String) `public` (connected to the internet) or `private` (traffic between your own machines only).
- `created_at` (String) When the network was created (RFC 3339).
- `fabric` (String) Fabric (i3D.net location) of the network, a `slug` from `i3dnet_fabrics`.
- `name` (String) Name of the network. Null when the network has no name.
- `retention` (String) `persistent` (stays until it is deleted) or `ephemeral` (i3D.net set it up for your account and removes it again together with what it was set up for).
- `routing_domain_id` (String) ID of the routing domain the network belongs to. Networks with the same value route traffic to each other. Set only when `routing_enabled` is `true`, null otherwise.
- `routing_enabled` (Boolean) Private networks only: `true` when the network has a gateway and routes traffic to your other networks in the same routing domain, `false` when it is isolated. Null on public networks.
- `state` (String) State of the network: `provisioning`, `active` or `failed`.
- `updated_at` (String) When the network last changed (RFC 3339).
- `vlan_id` (Number) VLAN ID of the network, to configure on servers attached to it. Null while the network is still being provisioned.
